title: Style Params — quantifiable style extracted from an example video/screenshot
description: Extracted by P2 from the example video/screenshot; consumed by P1 (folded into the plan) and mapped by apply_style into render_props. Describes AESTHETICS only, not the source video's face geometry (objectPosition/scenes are computed by P2 on the SOURCE video via face_tracker). All fields optional; if not detected, omit and the renderer falls back to template defaults. `confidence` lets P1 decide whether to ask the user for clarification.

ref.description: Example file path or description text

palette.description: Optional finer palette (hex). If given, P3 may override the colorMode's built-in palette.

bottomRatio.description: Distance from bottom as a ratio (0 = flush bottom)

speakerCard.description: Card treatment (not geometric position) — floating, corner radius, border. The position schedule `scenes` is NOT here.

occupiesRatio.description: Approx fraction of frame the card occupies; a sizing hint for P2 to generate scenes

chrome.description: Which persistent UI bars appear in the example

confidence.description: Per-field confidence 0..1 (set by P2 at extraction); P1 uses it to decide whether to clarify with the user
